description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), causes [DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)], grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quad Element Mode III (Fire, Earth, Wind, Poison)], [Legendary Engineer Mode] and [Volley Fire Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Quad Element Mode III (Fire, Earth, Wind, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Earth 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Poison 2 with Stacking] after using a Fire/Earth/Wind/Poison ability

description.name: Legendary Engineer Mode
description.text: Casts Turret Cover Fire every 4.00 seconds

description.name: Volley Fire Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Volley Fire after triggering Turret Cover Fire three times, removed if the character hasn't [Legendary Engineer Mode]
